author: pgaudet
body:
I am not sure how to replace these term, other than making extensions. I fixed the UniProt annotations. 

Thanks, Pascale

author: addiehl
body: The "involved in immune response" terms should just be replaced by their parents, with annotations transferred upward.

author: RLovering
body:
Hi Pascale, 

please can you give me more than 4 days notice before obsoleting terms as I like to double check that there aren’t annotations that need fixing that have been missed. Not that this happens very often but it is nice to check, in this case there was at least one annotation that was missed from the spreadsheet.

Also please could you let me know when there will be up to date online error reports available as I guess any annotations that are missing from the spreadsheet will be there

Many Thanks and Happy New Year

Ruth

author: pgaudet
body: Thanks @RLovering apologies, I had ran in unexpected problems, I will try to avoid this in the future.

author: pgaudet
body: Terms have been obsoleted. Annotations will appear in error reports.
